description: Find event businesses — AV and production companies, sound, lighting, staging, backline, video, DJs, live bands, entertainment agencies, planners, caterers, photographers, videographers, rentals, decor, staffing, security and transportation — by category, city and free text. Categories: av_production, sound, lighting, staging, backline, video, dj, live_band, entertainment_agency, event_planner, catering, photography, videography, party_rentals, decor_florals, event_staffing, security, transportation. Listings are researched from public websites with context.dev and cached; each result has the official website, description, services, public contact details and source URLs. A category and city that have not been researched yet are queued: research.status is "queued", whatever is already listed comes back, and the new listings appear within a few minutes. research.status "limited" means the daily research budget is spent, and "paused" or "unavailable" means research is off; cached listings are still returned. on_soundcheck=true marks a business that manages its own Soundcheck profile; its soundcheck_org_slug works with get_public_org and request_booking. Contact details are what the business publishes; nothing is invented.

category.description: kind of event business; with a city, an unlisted city is queued for research

country.description: country name or ISO-3166 alpha-2 code, e.g. "US"

query.description: free text matched against business name, description and services

name: search_businesses

data.description: tool payload (API/composite/confirmation object); object, array, or primitive JSON

title: Search event businesses
